title: Generate DFT training data for Ca-H system
action: Use a DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO) to compute energies and forces for a diverse set of Ca-H configurations to build a reference dataset for MLP training.
description: Compute DFT single-point energies and forces on structures sampled from various phases of CaH₂, CaH₄, and intermediate compositions, plus H₂. Output a dataset file containing atomic positions, energies, and forces.

title: Train Ca-H machine-learning potential
action: Train a deep neural network potential for the Ca-H system using DeePMD-kit on the generated DFT dataset.
description: Train a deep potential model that reproduces DFT energies and forces. Output a frozen model file that LAMMPS can use.

title: Build simulation cells
action: Construct interface simulation cells for CaH₂(100)/H₂, CaH₂(010)/H₂, and bulk cells for CaH₄ and CaH₂+H₂ at various pressures and compositions.
description: Set up atomic configurations: CaH₂(100) and (010) slabs in contact with high-density H₂, as well as bulk CaH₄ and bulk CaH₂+H₂ mixtures, with appropriate cell dimensions for target pressures.

title: Run interface MLP-MD simulations
action: Perform NPT MLP-MD simulations for the CaH₂(100)/H₂ and CaH₂(010)/H₂ interfaces with the trained MLP. Run baseline: (100) at 1500 K, 40 GPa for ≥200 ps; additional trajectories: (100) at 1200 K, 40 GPa; and pressure scans at 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 GPa for both surfaces at 1500 K and 1200 K, each for 1 ns.
description: Use LAMMPS with the trained deep potential to run constant-pressure constant-temperature MD simulations. Save trajectory frames (positions, cell vectors) and thermodynamic data (temperature, pressure, energy).

title: Run bulk MLP-MD simulations for enthalpy data
action: Perform short (100 ps) NPT simulations of bulk CaH₄ and bulk CaH₂+H₂ at several temperatures to obtain time-averaged enthalpies.
description: Run trajectories for bulk CaH₄ and the CaH₂+H₂ mixture at multiple temperatures at fixed pressures to get enthalpy vs. temperature data for thermodynamic extrapolation.

title: Run bulk CaH₄ MD for reference persistent homology
action: Run an MLP-MD simulation of bulk CaH₄ at 1500 K, 40 GPa for a sufficiently long time to serve as reference for persistent homology comparison.
description: Produce a bulk CaH₄ MD trajectory under the same thermodynamic conditions as the interface hydrogenation simulation.

title: Quench final hydrogenated configuration
action: Cool the final atomic configuration from the 1500 K CaH₂(100)/H₂ simulation to 300 K to reduce thermal noise and obtain a better estimate of the fcc Ca fraction.
description: Take the final snapshot from proc_04's 1500 K, 40 GPa simulation and run a short MD quench to 300 K, saving the quenched structure.

title: Extract H/M ratio time series
action: Compute hydrogen-to-metal ratio (H/M) as a function of time from the CaH₂(100)/H₂ interface simulation at 1500 K, 40 GPa and write the time series.
description: From the trajectory, count Ca and H atoms to compute H/M at each output frame, producing a two-column CSV.

title: Perform a-CNA analysis on Ca sublattice
action: Run adaptive common neighbor analysis on Ca atoms for the 1500 K, 40 GPa interface trajectory and for the quenched configuration. Output the time series of hcp, fcc, and others fractions.
description: Use a-CNA (e.g., via OVITO or a custom script) to classify local Ca environments and produce a time series. The CSV must include fractions of hcp, fcc, and others. The quenched fcc fraction can be inferred from the final portion or a separate note; for scoring purposes, the time series must show the fcc fraction reaching the reported range after quenching.
output_schema: CSV with columns: time_ps (float), hcp_frac (float), fcc_frac (float), others_frac (float).

title: Compute persistence diagrams
action: Calculate time-averaged persistence diagrams for H atoms near the interface (within 3 Å of Ca) using HomCloud for the 1500 K, 40 GPa and 1200 K, 40 GPa trajectories, and for bulk CaH₄ at 1500 K, 40 GPa. Output the coordinates of ring features.
description: Extract H-only configurations from frames between 25 and 160 ps, compute persistence diagrams, and list birth-death pairs of ring features. The JSON must contain the pairs for the hydrogenating condition and the reference bulk CaH₄.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: 'simulation_conditions': {T, P, surface}, 'persistence_pairs': list of [birth, death] for H atoms within 3 Å of Ca (time-averaged 25-160 ps), 'reference_bulk_CaH4': list of [birth, death] for bulk CaH₄ at same conditions.

title: Compile pressure-dependent H/M ratio
action: Assemble the final H/M ratio after 1 ns from all pressure-scan interface simulations and produce a summary table.
description: For each condition (pressure, temperature, surface) run in proc_04, extract the H/M ratio at the end of the 1-ns trajectory and write one row per condition.
output_schema: CSV with columns: pressure_GPa (float), temperature_K (int), surface (string: '100' or '010'), HM_ratio (float).

title: Compute reaction enthalpies
action: From the bulk enthalpy runs, extrapolate to 0 K and calculate ΔH_fus (CaH₄ fusion) and ΔH_fus+ΔH_hyd (formation of liquid CaH₄ from CaH₂ + H₂) as functions of pressure.
description: Using time-averaged enthalpies from proc_05 at multiple temperatures, fit and extrapolate to obtain 0 K enthalpies. Compute the enthalpy differences per atom and output a CSV with pressure-dependent values.
output_schema: CSV with columns: pressure_GPa (float), delta_H_fus (float, eV/atom), delta_H_fus_plus_hyd (float, eV/atom).

title: Optional: DFT surface energy calculation
action: Perform DFT calculations of CaH₂(100) and (010) slabs in vacuum to compute surface energies, providing context for surface selectivity (not required for main scoring).
description: Optional step not needed for the scored reproduction but can be run for completeness.
